**Plan, no changes made.**

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js) already gives full data, `owner` and `slow` included. `toTable` in [format.js](src/format.js) drops those two on purpose.

1. Parse `--json` in [cli.js](src/cli.js) alongside the `report` command.
2. If set, print `JSON.stringify(buildRows(), null, 2)` instead of `toTable(...)`.
3. Skip touching `format.js` — JSON output should keep all fields, not match the table's trimmed columns.

No tests exist yet, so I'd add one for the JSON path.
